attrs.name: 0826～0901有杀端行为的订单是否取消或改派

content.text:
select 
    a.order_id,
    a.hxz_get_kill_end_exist,
    a.hxz_get_kill_end_duration_s,
    b.is_cancel,
    b.is_reassign
from (
    SELECT  
        order_id,
        max(feature['hxz_get_kill_end_exist']) as hxz_get_kill_end_exist,
        max(feature['hxz_get_kill_end_duration_s']) as hxz_get_kill_end_duration_s
    FROM    experience_data.jury_strategy_public_middleware_v2
    WHERE   concat_ws('-', year, month, day) BETWEEN '2026-08-26' AND '2026-09-01'
        AND process_id = 10644
        AND strategy_version = '4.17'
        and feature['hxz_get_kill_end_duration_s'] > 0
    group by order_id
) as a 
inner join (
    select 
        order_id,
        max(is_td_cancel) as is_cancel,
        max(is_td_reassign) as is_reassign
    from 
        kflower_dw.dwd_kf_trd_unity_order_di
    where dt between '2026-08-26' AND '2026-09-02'
        and is_hxz = 1
    group by order_id
)as b
on a.order_id = b.order_id
